acceptanceCriteria: The cause is named (module layout, missing `go.mod` at the snapshot root, vendoring, or a gopls version limit) with a repro on one caddy and one etcd snapshot, and either the bench snapshots are prepared so gopls loads them or the TCP-V0-046 reading is re-labelled as measured with no gopls contribution on those repositories.
body:
Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-3 pull requests. Review of PR #98 (V1-0099): with real gopls on the bench snapshot caddyserver__caddy@aed1af59 all 39 of 39 queries returned 'no package metadata for file'; after the review fix such runs are reported `unavailable`. The V1-0099 BUILD-LOG recount shows 22 of 59 `loaded` runs with at least one relation; the 37 empty ones are caddy 13, etcd 23 and gin 1. Why gopls cannot load these snapshots was not investigated, so the TCP-V0-046 off/on numbers on those repositories measure the packet without any gopls contribution.

2026-09-29 investigation and correction: draft PR #362 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/362), clean head 4467590a662563f5e69e1ec9102490a9a3890384. The official v2_edit2ripple archive was checksum-verified and exact Caddy aed1af59 / etcd 5485c710 chunk snapshots reconstructed. Caddy go.mod and queried source are truncated; offline gopls v0.23 returns no package metadata. Etcd queried source is truncated, go.sum absent and nested module loading incomplete; current gopls resolves one definition, so the historical exact failure cause is not proved there. The V1-0099 zero-relation Caddy/etcd rows are now explicitly measured Core parity/cost with no gopls contribution, not semantic qualification. Focused docs checks and retrieval-bench unit tests passed; independent review had no findings; CEM 5 supported/0 unknown and dogfood check/seal passed. Pending: PR integration, cross-host CI, and ticket-required full-gate before native completion. No runtime behavior or benchmark data changed.
title: lspprovider: gopls answers `no package metadata for file` for every query on 37 of 59 loaded bench snapshots
